reworded.q: Passwords Hidden In App Code: Check All Apps Now Or Only New Changes?

a.label: Check All Apps Now
a.desc: Security looks through every app's code for passwords or keys saved by mistake (anyone who finds one can use that account) and removes them.

b.label: Only New Changes
b.desc: Security checks each new change before it goes live. Older code is left as it is.

reworded.q: Back Up Everything: Dropbox Or A Dedicated Backup Service? (Security Suggests A Backup Service)

a.label: Dropbox
a.desc: You already have it. It syncs chosen folders and keeps recently deleted files, but it is not a full backup of the computer.

b.label: Dedicated Backup Service
b.desc: Security's pick: backs up the whole computer automatically, encrypted, and keeps older versions longer. Small monthly fee.
